notes.title: We Are Released!
notes.content: We Are Square is finally out! Please check it out and leave a review if you enjoy it! Try not to hate your friends too much!

notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.content:
Hey Squares,

We ran into an approval issue when getting the game approved for launch. So the "real" launch date will happen shortly. But in the meantime, the demo is available to play today! And like the store page states, the demo is the full game, so we hope you enjoy!
